audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer gave all seven rows to 'Skill' while the content layer and the packet levelChart read Aurelion Sol / Skill / Skill / Aurelion Sol / Vladimir / Aurelion Sol / Aurelion Sol — five rows rendering two different answers.
audit.why: Content and packet agree with each other and with the kits: Breath of Light out-ranges Transfusion 750 to 600 and Vladimir pays his own health for Tides of Blood, so level 1 is yours; level 6 flips because Sanguine Pool is 2 seconds of untargetable on a 28s rank-1 cooldown and Hemoplague heals him off every champion it hits.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides aligned to the content layer as one atomic group, with phases[0].why, phases[3].why, phases[4].why and phases[5].why rewritten so each sentence argues for the side it now sits under.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and phase text referenced 'Starsurge' and 'Comet of Legend' — pre-rework Aurelion Sol abilities that no longer exist.
audit.why: Aurelion Sol's current kit is Breath of Light (Q), Astral Flight (W), the black hole (E) and Falling Star (R), which becomes The Skies Descend once enough Stardust is banked.
audit.corrected: Every reference replaced with the real ability and the real spike it describes.

audit.whatIsWrong: The two decisive interactions were never stated: Sanguine Pool's 2s untargetable eats Falling Star's stun, and Vladimir's healing needs Grievous Wounds.
audit.why: Vladimir's W carries the untargetable flag, his Q and R both carry the heal flag, and Aurelion Sol's R is the only hard CC in his kit — spending it into a pool wastes a 100-120s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Stated in enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, spikes[1].text, content mid, whys[5], breakdown.feeding and ahead.

audit.why: Real numbers exist: Sanguine Pool 28/25/22/19/16, Transfusion 9/7.9/6.8/5.7/4.6 at zero cost, Hemoplague a flat 120.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was mentioned only in report[8] and never in the writable advice fields.
audit.why: Transfusion costs no mana and returns every 4.6s at rank 5, and Hemoplague heals off every champion hit — Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds now named in whys[5], breakdown.feeding and ahead.
